description:
£162 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this spacious eight-bedroom student house, ideally located on Cavendish Place, one of Jesmond-s most popular student streets.

Perfect for a group of students looking for a well-located home, the property offers eight bedrooms, multiple bathrooms, a comfortable communal living room and a large kitchen/diner, providing plenty of space for both socialising and everyday living.

Situated in a sought-after student location, the property is ideally placed to enjoy everything Jesmond has to offer.

Early viewings are strongly recommended due to the popularity of this property! Contact My Property Box today and speak to our lettings team to arrange your viewing.
